title: Archive a directory's files into a zip or tar
description: Walks `source` and writes every file under it into a single `.zip` or `.tar` archive, preserving the directory's internal structure.

source.description: Directory to archive, relative to the workspace root.
source.x-prompt: Which directory would you like to archive?

destination.description: Directory the archive is written into, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to `source`.

filename.description: Archive filename, written under `destination`. Defaults to `<basename(source)>.<format>`.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing archive at the resolved output path. Without this, an existing archive is left untouched (with a warning).
